name: Weebly
description: Weebly is a free website builder, owned by Square, that lets entrepreneurs build a website and online store that grows with their business, with order management and payment processing built in.
best_for: Entrepreneurs and small business owners, from those just starting out to established businesses expanding online, who want a simple website and store builder backed by Square payments.
features: Customizable website and store templates with drag-and-drop editing
All-in-one order management for online and pop-up-shop sales

alternatives.name: Ecwid
alternatives.description: An ecommerce platform that lets businesses add a store to any existing website or sell across multiple channels.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting to add ecommerce to an existing site without rebuilding it.

alternatives.name: Squarespace
alternatives.description: A website builder and hosting platform with design templates and integrated ecommerce tools.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want a design-forward website with built-in selling tools.
